image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a metallic breastplate (cuirass) mounted against a plain, light-colored wall. The armor is silver-toned with visible etched or embossed linear patterns radiating from the center. It features a raised central ridge, curved side edges, and attachment points/straps at the shoulders. The surface shows signs of wear, tarnish, and uneven polishing, with strong specular highlights indicating a reflective metal material.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'cuirass' or generic 'armor'.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, etching details, and check for subtle AI-generation artifacts in the texture.
To confirm the 3D curvature and depth of the raised ridge and embossed patterns, ensuring they are physically grounded and not flat textures.

focus_areas: Metallic reflectivity and specular highlights consistency
Structural integrity of shoulder attachment points
Edge sharpness and boundary definition against background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the etched patterns and the light reflections. In AI images, etched details often fail to interact correctly with specular highlights (appearing flat or floating). Verify if the shoulder attachments look mechanically functional or merely decorative/painted on. Check for any 'melting' of the metal edges into the background.
